statements.statement: The service was a 48-hour Holter monitor
The service provides continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations (R00.2)
The palpitations interfere with daily activities
The monitoring was ordered to characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
